bundle.shortDescription: Turn a picture into a mosaic made of your own card images.
bundle.longDescription: Mosaic Generator rebuilds a picture out of a folder of card images, matching each spot by colour or by detail. It runs on NVIDIA (CUDA) and AMD/Intel (OpenCL) graphics cards, or on the processor, and saves a PNG or a zoomable Deep Zoom viewer.
